jobs.occupation: HVDC Primary & Valve Installation Supervisor (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Job DescriptionHVDC Primary & Valve Installation Supervisor (m/f/d)

GE Vernova is facing a momentum of hypergrowth, and we are currently scaling up our teams, creating others from scratch, and bringing our industry to the next level. Join us on this mission!

At GE Vernova Grid Solutions we are electrifying the world with advanced grid technologies. As leaders in the energy space our goal is to accelerate the transition for a more energy efficient grid to full fill the needs of tomorrow. With a focus on growth and sustainability GE Vernova Grid Solutions plays a pivotable role in integrating Renewables onto the grid to drive to carbon neutral.

Due to the growth of our HVDC business, we are currently looking for our next HVDC Primary & Valve Installation Supervisor in the “Construction & Commissioning” function to participate in this energy transition.

Your Mission: Within our large scale HVDC Projects you are responsible for the Supervision of the Installation for our HVDC Valves including the Valve Cooling System. The installation will be done by subcontractors.

This position implies functional leadership as an IC (Individual Contributor) without direct reports. It is a Construction Site based role.

Join us and enjoy playing a major role to enhance the Central Europe Construction & Commissioning function with fresh ideas!

Why we come to work:

At GE Vernova, our employees are always up for the challenge - and we’re always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you’ll need to bring a solution-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition.
Main Tasks/Responsibilities:

1. EHS
Ensure all installation activities are performed in accordance with safety protocols and regulatory requirements.
2. Quality Oversight
Implement quality control measures to ensure the reliability and performance of installed HVDC Valves & HVDC Primary Equipment.
Conduct inspections based on ITPs to verify adherence to quality standards.
Prepare and review installation documentation, test reports, and as-built drawings.
Ensure all tools, equipment, and materials are properly maintained and stored
3. Planning & Coordination
Coordinate the HVDC Primary Equipment & Valve installation activities with the Site Management Team and other internal and external stakeholders (Installation Subcontractor) on site.
Providing guidance, training and support as needed to the installation subcontractor
Coordinate with our internal Valve manufacturing to assure needed documentation is used at site during execution
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues that arise during the installation process
Technical education, preferably with a degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience in electrical- or mechanical installation works in large scale projects with at least 3 years experience in the relevant field.
Experience from Supervision or Site Management in substation, FACTS or HVDC Projects preferred.
Strong health and safety mindset aligned with international standards, with the ability to identify and stop unsafe work.
Strong interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to provide clear verbal and written reporting (English required).
Proactive mindset with the ability to recommend and approve corrective actions.
Professional Growth: Dynamic team, extensive resources, and training for skill development
A Booming industry with Cutting-Edge Projects: Involvement in high-profile, innovative projects
Global Exposure: Collaboration with a diverse, global network of industry experts
Collaborative Environment: Supportive culture fostering creativity and teamwork
A macro-management cultur...

jobs.occupation: Bachelor Thesis in the field of Quality Management / Behavioral Science (Elektroniker/in - Luftfahrttechnische Systeme)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the Quality Conformance Management, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Bachelor student (d/f/m) in the field of Quality Management / Behavioral Science, working title of thesis "Quality NC Eradication – Behavioral Quality Management (Nudging)".

You are looking for a bachelor thesis and want to get to know the work of a Quality Conformance Manager? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in Quality department of A320 FAL Hamburg as a Bachelor Student(d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg Finkenwerder
- Start: As soon as possible
- Duration: 14 weeks

Your location

You will be working at one of the largest production sites for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime) and opportunities for mobile working after department agreement.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally (you will be integrated into a young, highly motivated team composed of members from 10 different nationalities).
- Work with modern/diversified technologies and explore the field of nudging and behavioral science inside an operational business.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Support the Quality Conformance Manager in daily tasks, including continuous quality improvement, creating KPI-Dashboards, and updating Control Plans.
- Explore behavioral science—specifically "Nudges"—as a complement to traditional quality management for your thesis project.
- Analyze human factor challenges, such as shifted attention (Prospective Memory) or underestimating risks (Availability Heuristic).
- Investigate specific use cases, for example the "Scuff Plate Protection", where titanium plates are left unprotected.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Practical knowledge of Microsoft Suite or Google Workplace
- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of Business Psychology, Behavioral Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or an equivalent field of study.
- First practical experience in the field of project management and/or data analysis is desirable.
- Fluent in German and English.
- Self-organized individual with high motivation.
- A genuine interest in shaping quality and a curious mindset towards behavioral science.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth. Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

jobs.occupation: Model Based System Engineering (MBSE) Specialist (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the department Data Engineering in Hamburg, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for a

Model Based System Engineering (MBSE) Specialist (d/f/m)

As an MBSE Specialist, you will shape a key part of our Digital Transformation. This transformation aims to fundamentally revolutionize the development of future aircraft models. As the operational lead for MBSE, you are responsible for the practical implementation and scaling of Model-Based Systems Engineering within specific flagship projects. In doing so, you align consistently with the Engineering ​​Digital Agenda and drive the transformation process - moving from digitalization to AI-driven corporate transformation. Your focus lies on establishing robust data models to serve as a "single source of truth" and using them as a foundation to automate engineering system models.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours (min. 28 hours / week) and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Guide the introduction of MBSE as a development method for complex airframe projects.
- Co-create the MBSE Framework (method, language, tools) as a platform architecture for a distributed development environment in alignment with our Digital Agenda.
- Manage the technical MBSE environment and extend it to other product development activities.
- Integrate the MBSE method into existing business processes across the value chain.
- Evaluate and advance modeling methods and tools in alignment with corporate development requirements and partners.
- Provide practical support to project teams during system analysis, requirement definition, and system architecture modeling.
- Coordinate and integrate internal/external development partners and suppliers.
- Mentor and inspire team members through MBSE training and knowledge sharing.

Desired skills and qualifications

- University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or an equivalent qualification.
- Experience with relevant IT systems / digital twins and applications which can be linked in the frame of MBSE (e.g. CAPELLA, DOORS, CAMEO System Modeller, SYSML, UML, RCT, Web APIs).
- Solid understanding of requirements management, system modeling, system integration, V&V, configuration management, and software development (e.g. Python, C#, JavaScript).
- A passion for mastering MBSE and co-creating its successful implementation.
- High interest in MBSE standards (see following standards for your reference: ISO/IEC 15288, ISO12207, ARP 4754A).
- Experience defining and handling engineering and business processes.
- Strong teamwork, communication, organizational skills and a high capacity for abstract thinking.
- Negotiation-level proficiency in English open-mindedness regarding occasional travel.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

To apply, send us your CV along with a cover letter that tells us what inspires your enthusiasm for MBSE.

Start date - October 2027

Are you a university graduate with the aspiration, enthusiasm, and talent to help us pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world? Every year, Airbus seeks bright minds from around the globe to fill critical roles that will shape our future.

When you begin your career with us, we don't just offer a job; we accelerate your growth through the Airbus Global Graduate development journey. If you're ready to embark on this transformative journey and unlock your full potential, apply below.

As part of your application, PLEASE ATTACH A CV & COVER LETTER

What you will be doing

You will be on a development pathway to prepare you to be an Engineering Planning & Data Manager and can expect to be involved in the following:

- Plan and steer engineering customization activities within challenging projects to implement specific airline requests
- Performing Data Analytics tasks on the Airbus internal platform Skywise and other environments
- Contribute in shaping the future way of working while supporting digitalisation initiatives
- Unique possibility to get to know the aircraft customization from early definition up to certification and delivery, combining theory (processes and project management) and practice (manufacturing and delivery)
- gaining an insight in all the different areas involved in delivering a customised product with a focus on Cabin & Cargo

Your development pathway will include a minimum of one rotation on a different mission.

At the end of the 2 year development programme you will be fully equipped to be a key player as Engineering Planning & Data Manager.

What we look for

To be a successful applicant to the Airbus Global Graduate Programme, you will need to demonstrate you have:

- A degree level or equivalent within a relevant field of study
- Recently graduated or first professional experience in the field of engineering preferable with knowledge in data science or analytics
- Degree required: Bachelor degree
- Strong verbal and written communication in our business language (English)
- A desire to work in a collaborative team environment, focused on driving future innovation
- The ability to be self aware and a wish to be in the driving seat of your Development.
- Specific experience or interests: project management, strong communication skills, interested in digital trends and data oriented

Please note, we love your interest in working for Airbus but we do ask that you make only one application to the Airbus Global Graduate Programme. We encourage you to take time to decide which of our exciting opportunities is right for you and then submit an application that best represents you, your skills and experience in connection with the role you have selected.

Earlier this year (March 2026), Unilever announced an agreement to separate our Foods business. Our Foods business, including brands such as Hellmann's and Knorr, will join forces with McCormick to become a global flavour leader, with leading positions across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by a strong retail and food service platform. McCormick has 135+ years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. You’ll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters — for people and the planet.

Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger.

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Join our collaborative EMEA Instrument and Enterprise Service Quality team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to global healthcare, research, and safety. As a Supplier Quality Engineer III, you'll ensure the quality and reliability of our supply chain and support Quality Management System processes while contributing to our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

In this role, you'll manage supplier qualification processes, schedule and conduct comprehensive audits, and implement continuous improvement initiatives. You'll work with cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues, implement corrective actions, and maintain strong supplier and quality relationships.

Your expertise will be essential in developing and maintaining supplier/vendor quality metrics, managing quality agreements, and ensuring compliance and quality with industry standards and regulations.

Manage supplier performance, guide quality improvement projects, and contribute to new product introductions. You'll have the opportunity to support team development while working with a global network of professionals dedicated to excellence in quality management.
